To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the post-oxidation (POA) annealing time is an important parameter for controlling the interface and border trap charges in dielectrics on strained-SiGe layers and that the nitride incorporation into dielectrics reduces the border trap density.
(1) the border trap charge density decreases with POA time and (2) oxynitride dielectric is more stable under high-field stress than oxide dielectric.
the electrical properties of oxide and oxynidride films deposited on strained-Silicon Germanium layers are found to be dependent on post-oxidation time.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of POA and plasma composition on the electrical properties, especially border trap density and charge trapping behaviour of the deposited dielectric films on strained-SGO.81Ge0.18.
the effect of POA time on the electrical characteristics of dielectrics deposited on strained Si0.82Ge 0.18 layers.
the study of the effect of POA on the electrical properties (Dit, Qbt, ΔVG) of the deposited dielectrics on strained-SiGe layers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the POA process reduces the interface trap and border trap charge densities in both oxides and oxynitrides, while the oxynitride film deposited using plasma of TEOS/air mixture shows the least degradation in electrical properties.

the TEOS/NO-oxide film is the most stable film among the deposited films, which can be used to fabricate metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistors (MOSFETs) on strained-SiGe layers for high-performance applications.
the oxide and oxynite dielectrics deposited using plasma-assisted chemical vapour deposition (CVD) process are more stable compared with the thermal oxide dielectric.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the TEOS/NO-oxynitride films show better electrical characteristics than the TEOS-oxide films.
the oxide/oxynitride films deposited on strained-SicGe1-c layers at a low deposition temperature using TEOS, TEOS/O2 plasma and TEOS/ NO plasma have good electrical properties.
the use of TEOS/TEOS/NO plasma and POA is a good approach to obtain high-quality dielectrics on strained-SiGe layers.
The main takeaway from our work is that

POA is an effective technique to reduce the border trap charge density in the deposited oxides and oxynitrides on strained Si0.82Ge 0.18 layers and the TEOS/NO- plasma-deposited oxides and oxides have low border trap charge density.

the POA process can reduce the border trap generation in the case of deposited oxides and oxynitrides on strained-SiGe layers, and the TEOS/NO-deposited films are more resistant to the charge trapping under Fowler-Nordheim stress.
the use of plasma nitridation in the oxide film deposition process is a viable solution to mitigate the charge trapping in the gate oxide and oxynite films on strained Si0.82Ge 0.18.
